rationale: The Rust build job re-downloads crates from crates.io for every matrix build but has no dependency cache. Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (Cache dependency downloads) reports a measured benefit for caching dependency downloads and prescribes caching dependency download state keyed on a lockfile while keeping the full build and all required checks. The repository has a committed Cargo.lock, satisfying the precondition that cache inputs include the lockfile/environment, and no equivalent cargo cache already exists, so no contravention applies. Adding an actions/cache step for ~/.cargo/registry and ~/.cargo/git, keyed on runner.os and hashFiles('Cargo.lock'), restores pinned dependencies across the matrix without changing any build step, test, artifact, or permission. All seven platform targets and the frontend build remain unchanged.
